question: Targon (compute/targon): is the OpenAI-compatible chat API at api.targon.com/v1 still offered, and does it have any free usage? The provider's own site and docs index now describe only sandboxes, confidential GPU VMs and bare metal.
why: https://docs.targon.com/ (capture sha256:26a221762a2766a1ccb191e9b066ce27917a1b09f94e7500f112e301d5bf81d6) lists Sandboxes, Virtual Machines, Bare Metal and Compute resources under Guides, and https://targon.com/ (capture sha256:635b85adb326c9ec4ee2f149536b2bd826c5b356c4faf8ade51e2bf785f9f03d) describes a confidential compute cloud; neither mentions a chat or inference API. A chat API at api.targon.com/v1 is described only by third-party indexes (apis.io, api-evangelist) and a gateway page, which are leads and not evidence. The existing record prices GPUs and CPUs only.
